text: The SPF shall dispense food at scheduled times.
The SPF shall dispense a portion of 20 to 200 grams, adjustable in 5 gram increments.
The SPF shall dispense food quickly and quietly.
The SPF should notify the owner when the hopper is low.
The SPF shall store TBD days of food.
The SPF shall detect jams and shall attempt to clear them and shall notify the owner if the jam persists.
The hopper shall be easy to clean.
It shall support multiple pets as appropriate.
The SPF shall connect to the owner's home Wi-Fi network using WPA2 or WPA3.
The mobile app will display feeding history, hopper level, device status, etc.
The SPF shall send notifications in near real-time.
The SPF shall continue dispensing on schedule during a loss of network connectivity of up to 72 hours.
Firmware updates shall be applied.
The SPF shall minimize power consumption.
The SPF shall not dispense more than 3 portions within any 60 minute period.
The SPF shall operate in ambient temperatures from 0 °C to 40 °C.
The SPF shall be robust to tampering by pets, including but not limited to pawing, tipping, and chewing.
The SPF shall operate on battery backup for 48 hours if possible.
All exterior surfaces in contact with food shall be made of food-safe materials and/or BPA-free plastic.
The SPF shall withstand a drop of 1 onto a hard floor.
